name: Wu Yin Zhi Jian
source:
Summer 1995. You return to the secluded village of Iwao, surrounded by mountains, due to your grandfather's critical illness. An ancient shrine in the village is said to seal away the legendary yokai "Tsuchigumo". As the annual "Mushi Okuri Festival" approaches, the ritual flames threaten to awaken a millennium-old curse...

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3271070]Steam[/url]]
translation:
1995年夏天，由于祖父病重，你回到了四面环山的僻静村庄岩尾。据说村里有一座古老的神社，封印着传说中的妖怪“土云”。随着一年一度的“虫大栗节”临近，祭祀之火有可能唤醒千年之咒……

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3271070]Steam[/url]]
